description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The route-manifest additions were folded into config/route-manifest.json on 2026-08-05 and again when the earlier Golden Coast phases reached main, so these lists only contain exact reviewed deltas since that snapshot: the three Phase 7 sales-cash-transfer middleware mounts introduced by the Phase 16 HADI transfer guard. The source-text delta is empty because config/source-text-assertion-baseline.json was regenerated once audit-source-text-assertions learned to see relative-URL source reads; every test that was carried here as a reviewed delta is now recorded in that baseline, which is the canonical list. A new source-coupled test must be added here again, deliberately.
